questions: What is memory?
If the memory is full, can anything new get in?
What is tolerance?
If the tolerance is tightened, does that make rejection more likely?
What is self?
If self is altered, does it still count as self?
What is a checkpoint?
If the checkpoint is removed, does everything get through?
What is a transplant?
If the transplant looks settled, can it still fail later?
What is activation?
After activation, does it stay on permanently?
What is priming?
If priming is missed, is it too late to respond?
What is exhaustion?
If exhaustion sets in, can it recover after a rest?
What is presentation?
Does a successful presentation guarantee a response?
What is escape?
If escape succeeds, is it out of danger for good?
What is selection?
If selection is successful, are the ones left automatically harmless?
What is a clone?
If one clone goes bad, do all the copies go bad too?
What is a repertoire?
If the repertoire gets smaller, can it still handle something unfamiliar?
What is neutralization?
After neutralization, is the threat completely gone?
What does a boost do?
When the boost wears off, is everything back where it started?
